import base64, hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin')

 print(n,'command metadata keys:',','.join(l.split('=',1)[0] for l in t.splitlines()))
